title: Use an updater to drop a state dependency

slides.say: Each new chat message makes the chat reconnect. Look at what the Effect reads.
The Effect reads messages, so messages is a dependency. A new message changes messages, which re-syncs the Effect, which reconnects.
Pass an updater instead. The Effect no longer reads messages at all, so it is not a dependency anymore.

slides.text: React gives the updater the latest value during the next render.
slides.say: React queues the updater and passes it the latest messages during the next render.
